a104c8fc-53b3-42da-82ae-59df7e57bc96.line: 这破店连我常嚼的那牌子口香糖都没了，随便买点凑合吧，真扫兴。
随便买点口香糖嚼嚼，今天赛道上的对手真是弱得让人犯困啊~

a130abb1-b21d-439b-9295-725bc9237971.line: 刚搞到把超顺手的进口扳手，晚上干活终于不用那么费劲了。
连着修了三台爆缸的车，这破洗手液根本洗不掉老娘手上的机油味！

27bea49c-7687-41b3-85c9-b8a22feb2fe5.line: 进食只是为了维持身体机能，黑咖啡能保证下午开会不犯困。

42e461eb-9415-4abe-8c47-ecfdaccd5458.line: 刚订的碳纤维方向盘到了，手感绝了，明天下赛道跑两圈试试。

items.imgPrompt: A black carbon fiber racing helmet, glossy finish, sitting on a dark leather sofa, minor scratches on the clear visor, natural lighting.

desc.zh: 喲，贊助商送多了。想跟在我屁股後面吃尾氣的話，建議買個戴上保命。陸二少，你需要嗎？
desc.zh_cn: 哟，赞助商送多了。想跟在我屁股后面吃尾气的话，建议买个戴上保命。陆二少，你需要吗？
desc.en: Yo, sponsors gave me too many. If you wanna eat my exhaust fumes, suggest you buy this to save your life. Second Young Master Lu, need one?

items.imgPrompt: A half-open cardboard box of imported mint chewing gum packets, colorful wrappers, resting on a metal garage workbench, slightly crumpled cardboard box.

name.zh: 進口薄荷口香糖（整盒缺三粒）
name.zh_cn: 进口薄荷口香糖（整盒缺三粒）
name.en: Imported Mint Chewing Gum (Box, missing 3 pieces)

desc.zh: 嚼了幾粒，薄荷味太淡了。在終點線等你們這些慢吞吞的廢物太無聊，得換點更刺激的提神。
desc.zh_cn: 嚼了几粒，薄荷味太淡了。在终点线等你们这些慢吞吞的废物太无聊，得换点更刺激的提神。
desc.en: Chewed a few pieces, the mint flavor is too weak. Waiting for you slow trash at the finish line is boring, need something stronger to stay awake.

items.imgPrompt: A sleek carbon fiber car steering wheel with red stitching and alcantara grips, placed on a wooden table, pristine condition, racing garage background.

desc.zh: 全新，單純覺得手感不行就拆了。別以為換上這玩意兒就能贏我……想贏？下輩子吧。
desc.zh_cn: 全新，单纯觉得手感不行就拆了。别以为换上这玩意儿就能赢我……想赢？下辈子吧。
desc.en: Brand new, just didn't like the grip so I took it off. Don't think swapping this in will make you beat me... Wanna win? Maybe in your next life.

items.imgPrompt: A tarnished silver runner-up racing trophy cup, slightly dusty and oxidized, sitting on a cluttered garage metal shelf, metallic texture.

desc.zh: 俱樂部倉庫翻出來的破爛。第二名就是頭號輸家，看著礙眼，隨便賣。勝者為王，懂不懂？
desc.zh_cn: 俱乐部仓库翻出来的破烂。第二名就是头号输家，看着碍眼，随便卖。胜者为王，懂不懂？
desc.en: Junk dug out from the club warehouse. Second place is just the first loser. It's an eyesore, selling it cheap. Winner takes all, understand?

items.imgPrompt: Thick black luxury sunglasses with silver cross motifs on the temples, resting on a dark car dashboard, slight smudges on the lenses, sunny interior.

desc.zh: 戴過一次。畢竟從後視鏡看你們被甩遠的樣子太刺眼，但這鏡框太重了，影響我單手開車。
desc.zh_cn: 戴过一次。毕竟从后视镜看你们被甩远的样子太刺眼，但这镜框太重了，影响我单手开车。
desc.en: Wore it once. After all, the glare from the rearview mirror when I leave you all behind is too bright, but the frame is too heavy, messes with my one-handed driving.

items.imgPrompt: A folded black and red nylon racing jacket, sitting on a metal workbench next to oily rags, slightly dusty, no text, 20 words.

name.zh: 賀准車隊官方紀念夾克
name.zh_cn: 贺准车队官方纪念夹克
name.en: He Zhun Racing Team Official Jacket

desc.zh: 清櫃子翻出來的，一次沒穿過，看到這配色就反胃。買回去當抹布擦機油挺好，或者你要是賀准的粉絲就趕緊拿走，別髒了我的地盤！
desc.zh_cn: 清柜子翻出来的，一次没穿过，看到这配色就反胃。买回去当抹布擦机油挺好，或者你要是贺准的粉丝就赶紧拿走，别脏了我的地盘！
desc.en: Found this cleaning my locker, never worn, the colors make me sick. Good for wiping engine oil, or if you're a fan of his, just take it away and stop polluting my space!

items.imgPrompt: A damaged, scorched metal engine piston sitting on a wooden desk, clean but showing heat discoloration and deep scratches, industrial paperweight, 21 words.

name.zh: 報廢的鍛造活塞（可當鎮紙）
name.zh_cn: 报废的锻造活塞（可当镇纸）

desc.zh: 拜我們那位單細胞老闆上個月的“神級”過彎所賜，缸爆了。我洗乾淨了，拿來當鎮紙或者砸核桃都不錯，順便警醒你千萬別像陸延那麼開車！
desc.zh_cn: 拜我们那位单细胞老板上个月的“神级”过弯所赐，缸爆了。我洗干净了，拿来当镇纸或者砸核桃都不错，顺便警醒你千万别像陆延那么开车！
desc.en: Courtesy of our single-celled boss's "god-tier" cornering last month, the cylinder blew. I cleaned it up, great as a paperweight or for smashing walnuts. Let it remind you never to drive like Lu Yan!

items.imgPrompt: A pristine, unopened high-end eyeshadow palette in sleek black packaging, resting on a greasy metal toolbox, sharp contrast between clean makeup and dirty background, 24 words.

desc.zh: 陸延腦子抽風發的所謂“女生節福利”。我天天鑽車底，拿這玩意兒幹嘛？給剎車卡鉗上色嗎？ticiy，你要是也不要我就直接扔了，看著心煩。
desc.zh_cn: 陆延脑子抽风发的所谓“女生节福利”。我天天钻车底，拿这玩意儿干嘛？给刹车卡钳上色吗？ticiy，你要是也不要我就直接扔了，看着心烦。
desc.en: Lu Yan's brain short-circuited and he gave this as a "Women's Day bonus." I'm under cars all day, what am I supposed to do with this? Paint the brake calipers? ticiy, if you don't want it either, I'm tossing it.

items.imgPrompt: A heavy-duty steel dial torque wrench, slightly scuffed handle, resting on a wooden garage workbench, well-maintained but visibly used, 19 words.

name.zh: 閒置的指針式扭矩扳手
name.zh_cn: 闲置的指针式扭矩扳手

desc.zh: 換了數顯的，這把退役。精度我一直維護得很好，定期校準。如果你連扭矩參數是什麼都不懂就別拍，我不想我的工具被外行糟蹋。
desc.zh_cn: 换了数显的，这把退役。精度我一直维护得很好，定期校准。如果你连扭矩参数是什么都不懂就别拍，我不想我的工具被外行糟蹋。
desc.en: Upgraded to a digital one, so this is retiring. I've maintained the accuracy perfectly with regular calibration. If you don't even know what torque specs are, don't buy it. I won't let amateurs ruin my tools.

items.imgPrompt: A large, glossy carbon fiber car rear wing, leaning against a garage wall, minor installation scratches near the mounting brackets, concrete floor, 22 words.

name.zh: 浮誇碳纖維大尾翼（毫無氣動作用）
name.zh_cn: 浮夸碳纤维大尾翼（毫无气动作用）
name.en: Flashy Carbon Fiber Rear Wing (Zero Aerodynamics)

desc.zh: 陸延背著我瞎買的改裝件，說“看著帥”。帥個屁！不僅不能提供下壓力，還會增加風阻！我已經把它從車上拆下來了，哪個外觀黨想裝x就買走，別告訴別人是我賣的！
desc.zh_cn: 陆延背着我瞎买的改装件，说“看着帅”。帅个屁！不仅不能提供下压力，还会增加风阻！我已经把它从车上拆下来了，哪个外观党想装x就买走，别告诉别人是我卖的！
desc.en: A mod Lu Yan bought behind my back because it "looks cool." Bullshit! It provides zero downforce and just adds drag! I already ripped it off the car. Any poser who wants to show off can take it, just don't tell anyone I sold it!
